general_information.Syllabus Name: Human Computer Interaction_Tương tác người máy
general_information.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
general_information.Description: This course provides an introduction to these areas below: - Provides an introduction to interaction design - How theory and research findings have been applied to interaction design. - Comprehensive view of the various interface design - Data gathering, analysis, interpretation and presentation in Interaction Design - Techniques for establishing requirements, prototyping and design - Various approaches to evaluation design Assessment scheme: 1) On-going Assessment: - At least 3 progress tests: 25% - 02 Assignments: 30% - 01 presentation: 5% 2) Final exam: 40% (ABET c) 3) Final Result: 100% Completion Criteria: 1) Every on-going assessment component >0 2) Final Exam Score >=4 & Final Result >=5
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend more than 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises given by instructor beffore, in and after class and submit on time - Constantly follow announcements on intranet/CMS at http://cms.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information regarding assignment submission and feedback on assignments and project work.
general_information.Tools: Reference: 1Human-Computer Interaction. Serengul Smith-Atakan, Middlesex University Press, Thomson Learning, 2006 (in which there are guidelines how to use the book, and activities, review questions for each chapter) - chapter presentations (ppt.) - case studies (pdf) - additional resources (.doc) in a CD-ROM 2) Articles and activities on http://www.id-book.com/ Technical requirements:: - Project assignment(s) of this course is preferable to be integrated in a .NET (or Java) project . - Internet access
